selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found inferValidationCommands treated a package check script as exclusive: when scripts.check existed, test/lint/typecheck/build inference was skipped. A passing check could therefore mask a failing test and produce false acceptance evidence.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through the singular evidence-rich central bottleneck gate; no mode rotation was forced.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing use committed DWAC source-contract replay over fresh canonical main while the provider remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.observed: inferValidationCommands selected only npm run check because check used an if/else gate, so inferred acceptance could pass without executing the failing test script.

changes: Package script inference keeps check first when present but no longer treats it as exclusive.
test, lint, typecheck and build are appended when declared, subject to the existing four-command cap.
The existing Python pytest fallback remains active only when no package validation command was inferred.
A regression proves a passing check can no longer mask a failing test; acceptance executes both and fails closed on the failing test.

validation.tests: 13/13 PASS; 0 skipped on the POSIX validation host

truth_boundaries: This closes one false-positive validation path for package scripts; it does not claim exhaustive validation discovery for monorepos or every language/toolchain.
The existing four-command inference cap remains in force.
pyproject pytest inference still acts as a fallback when no package validation command exists; mixed-language repository validation remains a separate observation frontier.
This is not an OS-level filesystem/network sandbox; validation workspace confinement remains unresolved.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O/process failure remains unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
